lines.en: I walk over the gravel of the Dead Valley.
The wind here is dry.
Sand works between my toes.
I step around the cracks.
I walk steady. I know this place.

lines.zh: 我的影子在石头上拖很长。
lines.en: My shadow drags long across the stone.
I stop to sniff the air.
Little lives in the Dead Valley.
I follow the dry riverbed.
I can leap that pile of stones.

lines.zh: 我踩着干裂的谷底，几乎无声。
lines.en: Across the cracked valley floor I move almost silently.
I walk slowly toward that shade.
The days here are too long.

lines.zh: 我绕着一根倒下的柱子走。
lines.en: I circle a fallen pillar.
Dust is on my back.
I stop when I'm tired.
I lie beside the stone.

lines.zh: 枯谷的风把我的耳朵吹得贴住。
lines.en: The dead valley wind plasters my ears flat.

lines.zh: 我望着枯谷尽头，耳朵转来转去。
lines.en: I watch the valley's end, ears swiveling.
The Dead Valley sky is empty.

lines.zh: 我坐在枯树下，舔掉爪上的沙。
lines.en: Under a dead tree I lick the sand from my paws.
There's nothing to chase here.
I listen sideways.
Somewhere a stone falls.
I tuck my hind legs in.
I'm used to the stones of the dead valley.

lines.zh: 我挪到阴凉一点的地方。
lines.en: I shift into a cooler spot.

lines.zh: 风不停，我的耳朵一直竖着。
lines.en: The wind won't drop; my ears stay up.

lines.zh: 我嗅你的靴子，猜你走了多远。
lines.en: I sniff your boots and guess how far you walked.
That smell isn't from here.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看有没有食物。
lines.en: I watch your hands for food.
You've stepped into my shadow.
I'm not afraid of you.
But I don't plan to get close either.

lines.zh: 你把拳头摊开，让我闻一闻。
lines.en: Open your fist and let me sniff.
Just stand still.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了死谷的土。
lines.en: Your boots carry Dead Valley dust.
I know that soil.
You won't last long here.
I can tell.

lines.zh: 你的棍子擦过我的侧腹。
lines.en: Your club grazed my flank.
I gave half a step on the gravel.
That one knocked me askew.
I crouch low and guard my flank.

lines.zh: 背上的土被震落，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Dirt shaken from my back; I shudder it off.

lines.zh: 后腿挨了一下，我仍能跑。
lines.en: My hind leg takes a hit; I can still run.
That landed on bone.
I bared my teeth.
I'll keep that blow between my teeth.
I can be tamed; don't rush me.
What are you holding?
There's a smell here.
I'm not sure it's edible.
Put it down and I'll look.
There's no such smell in the Dead Valley.
What's in your hand smells good.
In dead valley wind, I shift half a step.

lines.zh: 你把食物放低，我才肯过去。
lines.en: Lower the food, and only then will I come.
Dead Valley wind smells of bone ash.
Do you have more of it?
The Dead Valley taught me to wait.
Don't rush me.
You hit me in the crevice.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀偏开，让你先过。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder aside to let you pass.
The stones here are harder than you.

lines.zh: 我的尾尖扫到你，收着点脚。
lines.en: My tail tip brushes you. Watch your feet.
Your foot slipped.

lines.zh: 从你两腿之间穿过去了。
lines.en: I slipped through between your legs.
Ash from the dead valley settles on my scales.
You broke a patch of gravel underfoot.

lines.zh: 你撞得我抖落背上的红土。
lines.en: Your bump shakes the red dust off my back.
The path is too narrow.

lines.zh: 死谷里没几只我这样的。
lines.en: There aren't many like me in the Dead Valley.
Not the place for that.
I'm used to being here alone.
When the wind rises, all scents scatter.

lines.zh: 我背上的鳞，被风磨得发亮。
lines.en: The wind has polished the scales on my back.
I'm still looking for water.
Wait for the rainy season.
Something moved behind the stone.
Not my kind.
I'll settle somewhere else.
I found this.
It's hard as stone.
I bit it. Can't break it.
This fell off you.
I push it under a stone to hide.
This stone isn't food. I push it away.
I paw the dirt twice.
It's too bright.
Bright things draw attention.
I won't keep it on me.
A shadow behind the pillar.
Not a stone.
I crouch lower than before.

lines.zh: 死谷的沙进了我的趾缝。
lines.en: Sand from the dead valley works into my toes.
I work my way downwind.
Either prey or trouble.

lines.zh: 我走到下风，味道才不会散。
lines.en: I move downwind so the scent stays clear.
Keep my steps silent.
Sound carries far in the Dead Valley.
Let me look before anything else.
I press my body to the ground.

lines.zh: 风送来的味道，越来越清楚。
lines.en: The scent on the wind grows clearer.

lines.zh: 石柱挡路，我从它的阴影绕过。
lines.en: The pillar blocks me; I slip around its shadow.

lines.zh: 死谷里的东西都不好惹。
lines.en: Nothing here is easy to deal with.
I keep to the stones.
That gap is just wide enough.
I can squeeze into the Dead Valley's cracks.
It's moving.

lines.zh: 我伏在石后，数着你的步子。
lines.en: Crouched behind a stone, I count your steps.
The wind changed again.

lines.zh: 你还没转头，我先压低身子。
lines.en: Before you turn, I flatten myself down.
I creep forward.
The stones hurt my feet.
I back away.
Not worth the chase.
I slip into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 它还没走远，死谷的风把气味送来。
lines.en: It has not gone far; the dead valley wind carries the scent.
I follow slowly.
I pounced once.
My claws scraped stone.
I miss and my teeth close on air.
I spat out the sand in my mouth.
It pulled back.
I pounce again.
My teeth aren't that sharp.
That's enough to send it running.
I'll hold my ground here.
I won't chase past this.

lines.zh: 死谷的石缝，我刚爬出来。
lines.en: Out of a dead-valley crack, just now.
The wind rushes in at once.
The sun in the Dead Valley is brutal.
I settle in the shade.
There are rarely living people here.
And yet here you are.

lines.zh: 死谷里，我绕着你走了半圈。
lines.en: In the dead valley, I circled half around you.
I don't mean to come closer.

lines.zh: 这里的石头我认得每一块。
lines.en: I know every stone here.
There's a dusty taste in the air.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的毛，焦味很冲。
lines.en: Fire caught my fur. The smell is sharp.

lines.zh: 从石台上滑下来，我稳住了。
lines.en: I slid off the ledge and caught myself.
There was water under the dry bed. I choked.

lines.zh: 炸起的碎石打在我身上。
lines.en: Blown stone chips struck me.

lines.zh: 箭擦过肩胛，划开一道浅口。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my shoulder blade, opening a shallow cut.

lines.zh: 一道光打过来，我眼前一白。
lines.en: A flash came and my sight went white.

lines.zh: 死谷没什么可吃，我越来越瘦。
lines.en: Little to eat in the Dead Valley. I'm thinning.

lines.zh: 雷打在石柱上，我耳朵贴平了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the pillar; my ears flatten.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地，也没有风。
lines.en: No ground in the void, and no wind.
